meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把一个 NanoClaw 智能体组从 Anthropic API 切到本地 Ollama 模型:检查代码支持、改 container.json 写入环境变量、设置模型名、重启服务,并验证请求确实走到本地。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体跑在本地、减少 API 开销或试用开源权重模型时触发;前提是本机已装好并运行 Ollama、已拉取模型、目标 agent group 已存在。

howto.what_en: Claude helps switch a NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model: it checks code support, edits container.json env vars, sets the model, restarts the service, and verifies requests reach Ollama.
howto.when_en: Use when you want your agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models; requires Ollama installed and running, a pulled model, and an existing agent group.
